Deposit $50 into a Anthias Labs curated vault on Base and keep the shares. Cost: $50 of capital and about $6 of gas. Time: 15 minutes.
Repeat one small qualifying action each week: a deposit, a borrow, a swap or a governance vote. Uneven weeks count as real use. Cost: about $3 of gas a week. Time: 10 minutes a week.
Keep the first position open for at least 60 days so more than one weekly snapshot records the activity. Cost: the $50 stays in the position. Time: 60 days.
Check the protocol's own points or rewards page before you withdraw, and claim only from the link the protocol publishes itself. Cost: no cost to check; never pay to claim. Time: 10 minutes.
Record the wallet address, each date and every transaction hash in a farm log, so you can prove the activity and unwind cleanly. Cost: nothing beyond the log. Time: 5 minutes.
Set a reminder to re-check Anthias Labs's own announcements monthly; stop farming if the protocol says no token is planned. Cost: no capital at risk. Time: monthly, 5 minutes.
